coordinate_system.axes: x right, y down, positive constructed z toward viewer
coordinate_system.old_anchor_status: Preserve original files and observed endpoint interface. This is not a user prohibition on approved non-destructive repair copies.

measurement_method: Manual visual landmark annotation on actual alpha-composited native pixel source + independent visual cross-check. Existing anchor coordinates are approximate observed centers, not an automated fit or inferred rig replacement.

bone_construction.method: Keep each annotated 2D endpoint exactly. Lift elbow z=sqrt(Lupper^2-d2D_upper^2); wrist z=elbow_z+sqrt(Lfore^2-d2D_fore^2). Same positive branch and same lengths for all frames. New XY positions are a hand-designed continuous arc, not borrowed code geometry.
bone_construction.rationale: 310/240 encloses all measured projected arm spans with plausible foreshortening; approximately 0.77 forearm/upper ratio is a construction choice checked against the neutral turnaround, not recovered anatomy. Side/pose depth is underdetermined.
bone_construction.limitation: Exact algebraic lengths do not prove anatomical plausibility or production-frame compliance. Hidden joint centers and depth must remain reviewable.

static_anchor_policy.button_H_role: independent diagnostic, never fit away body drift; legacy k06/k07 H residual documented
static_anchor_policy.plate_target_basis: OPTIONAL DECISION OVERLAY for acquisition segment only: k06/k07 horizontal center and size, y918 chosen for comparison. Not a global repaint instruction; A/C retain their frozen source background pixels.

legacy_conflicts.detail: k04 native center(455,920), k05(413,901), k06/07(453,912). Cannot keep old rendered pixels unchanged and also eliminate this prop jump by adding only 13 frames. A/C new states retain the corresponding source static pixels. B new plate layer remains pending; fixed target appears only as an optional decision overlay, not an authorized repaint.
legacy_conflicts.freeze_decision_needed: Opus chooses retain documented legacy jump OR authorize non-destructive scene plate isolation/replacement under an explicit per-anchor mask. Do not repaint source anchors.

legacy_conflicts.detail: k03->k04->k05 changes head orientation back and forth. New states close real endpoints; old head drawings are not silently made monotonic.

k01-04 contain legacy light cool fill; k05-07 neutral baseline. All new frames must have neutral material colors. Old cool-fill handling needs explicit render-profile agreement to avoid a second cool multiplication.

lighting_interface.new13: neutral unlit/base colors only, scene light applied once downstream
lighting_interface.legacy_k01_k04: preserve baked-light provenance; no second identical cool multiplier; any neutralization is a separate explicitly approved operation
lighting_interface.legacy_k05_k07: neutral base; single scene light pass
lighting_interface.forbidden: Do not grade new drawings individually to match the prelit old cool subset.

authoring_rule: Within each chain derive from the previous accepted drawing, always include the next frozen endpoint as constraint. A frozen anchor restarts that chain. Do not generate thirteen unrelated standalone frames.
